follow_up: In-memory role store — not persisted across restarts.

claim_text: Commitment engine tracks create/fulfill/cancel with audit trail
evidence_notes: create_commitment() fulfill_commitment() cancel_commitment() — all recorded in EvidenceLedger with tenant_id actor and payload.
follow_up: In-memory commitment store — not persisted across restarts.

claim_text: JSONL audit logger with correlation IDs and secret redaction
evidence_notes: log_event() with 7 valid kinds (propose approve reject execute purge replay license_check). _get_or_create_correlation() shares correlation_id across events for one action_id. redact_payload() applied to extra values.
follow_up: Local JSONL only — no telemetry egress.

claim_text: Quota ledger enforces monthly allowance per tenant; default allowance is 0 (Echo-limited)
evidence_notes: _row() returns default allowance=0. remaining = max(allowance - used 0). When file is missing default allowance is 0 — Echo-limited not an implicit paid pool.
follow_up: Quota is consulted outside execute — complete_safe checks before calling provider.

claim_text: Helm chart present for Kubernetes deployment
evidence_notes: Chart.yaml deployment.yaml service.yaml values.yaml present in tree. Implies possible hosted deployment path but does not contradict local-first core.
follow_up: Helm chart is for demo/dev deployment — not the product loop.
